data.narrative:
CX2 Industries is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 same-sector companies at Series A and Series B stages, including 8 private firms (Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and others) and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The peer cohort exhibits valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B, with a median of $1.0B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $62M based on the $31M capital raised proxy. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comp set produces $1.0B, anchored by Series B valuations including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B).

The triangulated valuation range spans $53M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $531M. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and maturity differences within the peer set; the median likely represents a reasonable center-point for a Series A company demonstrating traction comparable to the lower-quartile Series B entrants. Key uncertainties include CX2's revenue trajectory relative to peers, capital efficiency, and customer concentration in an evolving defense contracting landscape.
